parsed.change_summary: Added checks to ensure that `currentLink` is within bounds before accessing `node2Data[currentLink]`.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger `currentLink >= node2Data.size()` is blocked by adding checks at lines 26 and 39. If `currentLink` is out of bounds, the code now skips processing and moves to the next link or continues the loop, preventing out-of-bounds reads.
